article_title: Spotify uploads Irish lyrics for Dolly Parton's Welsh Jolene version

tasks.prompt: What is the main point of the article?
options: Spotify mistakenly showed Irish lyrics for a Welsh version of “Jolene” involving Dolly Parton.
Dolly Parton recorded the original “Jolene” entirely in Irish.
Spotify removed every recording of “Jolene” from its service.
Bronwen Lewis discovered that Dolly Parton had no Welsh ancestry.
tasks.correct_answer: Spotify mistakenly showed Irish lyrics for a Welsh version of “Jolene” involving Dolly Parton.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בטעות של ספוטיפיי: לגרסה הוולשית של Jolene הוצגו מילים באירית.

tasks.prompt: Who performed on the Welsh version with Dolly Parton?
options: Carl Dean and a bank clerk

tasks.prompt: What did Spotify do after the BBC contacted the company?
options: It replaced the song with the 1973 recording.
It added a Welsh translation immediately.
It removed the incorrect lyrics.
It deleted every cover version.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לאחר פניית ה-BBC, ספוטיפיי הסירה את המילים השגויות.

tasks.prompt: How did the Welsh collaboration begin?
options: Spotify asked Parton to translate the song.
Parton met Lewis at the 1974 Grammy Awards.
Jada Star heard Lewis on a radio programme in Nashville.
Lewis posted her Welsh translation online, and Star contacted her.

tasks.explanation_hebrew: לואיס פרסמה ברשת תרגום וולשי שלה, וג'אדה סטאר פנתה אליה והציעה להקליט אותו.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “posthumous” mean?
options: Released after the artist's death
Sung in more than one language
Recorded without musical instruments
Popular for more than fifty years

tasks.prompt: Why is “Jolene” described as one of Parton's best-known songs?
options: It was her only song written in 1973.
It was first performed in Wales.
It earned major chart success, many covers and more than a billion Spotify streams.
It was written by Jada Star about a singer from Conwy.

tasks.explanation_hebrew: הישגי המצעדים, ריבוי גרסאות הכיסוי ויותר ממיליארד השמעות מעידים על פרסום רחב ומתמשך.
